ggplot-based Dashboard for mvr Models

Source: R/gg_plots.R
gg_dashboard.Rd

Create a multi-panel dashboard from existing ggplot-based model views. The default dashboard uses score, loading, validation (R2), and prediction panels. Alternative panels can be selected with panels.

Usage

gg_dashboard(
  object,
  panels = c("scores", "loadings", "prediction", "validation"),
  plotly = FALSE,
  panel_args = list(),
  height = 300
)

Arguments

object

an mvr object.

panels

character vector of panel names. Supported panels are "score", "loading", "validation", "prediction", "biplot", "corr" and "coef".

plotly

logical. If TRUE, return an HTML dashboard containing independent Plotly widgets. If FALSE, return a static dashboard composed with gridExtra.

panel_args

named list of named lists. Each element provides arguments passed to the corresponding panel function.

height

positive numeric height in pixels for each Plotly panel.

Value

A composed dashboard object. In static mode, a gtable (drawn automatically in interactive sessions, returned invisibly); in plotly mode, an htmltools HTML container.

Examples

data(yarn)
mod <- plsr(density ~ NIR, ncomp = 6, data = yarn, validation = "CV")

if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("gridExtra", quietly = TRUE)) {
  gg_dashboard(mod, panel_args = list(prediction = list(ncomp = 3)))
}

if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("plotly", quietly = TRUE)) {
  gg_dashboard(mod, plotly = TRUE)
}
